description: This file defines the Editor class for a rich text editor, including methods for formatting, inserting content, handling events, and managing editing state. It imports various core modules and editing components, and exports the Editor class as the default export.

classes.name: Editor
classes.description: Main class for managing rich text editing, including formatting, content insertion, event handling, and state management.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the Editor instance with context, setting up modules, event handlers, and default states.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Binds event handlers, sets initial content, and records initial undo state.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes all event handlers from the editable area.

methods.name: handleKeyMap
methods.description: Handles keyboard shortcuts based on key mappings.

methods.name: preventDefaultEditableShortCuts
methods.description: Prevents default actions for certain keyboard shortcuts like bold, italic, underline.

methods.name: isLimited
methods.description: Checks if the content length exceeds maximum allowed length.

methods.name: createRange
methods.description: Creates and returns a new selection range.

methods.name: saveRange
methods.description: Saves the current selection range, optionally collapsing it.

methods.name: restoreRange
methods.description: Restores the last saved selection range.

methods.name: saveTarget
methods.description: Stores a target node for future operations.

methods.name: clearTarget
methods.description: Clears the stored target node.

methods.name: restoreTarget
methods.description: Retrieves the stored target node.

methods.name: currentStyle
methods.description: Returns the current style at the cursor position.

methods.name: styleFromNode
methods.description: Gets style information from a DOM node.

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Reverts to the previous editing state.

methods.name: redo
methods.description: Reapplies the last undone change.

methods.name: beforeCommand
methods.description: Prepares for executing a command, triggering events and focusing.

methods.name: afterCommand
methods.description: Finalizes command execution, normalizes content, records undo, and triggers change event.

methods.name: tab
methods.description: Handles tab key press, inserting tab or navigating table cells.

methods.name: untab
methods.description: Handles shift+tab key press, navigating table cells backward.

methods.name: wrapCommand
methods.description: Wraps a function to execute it with before and after command hooks.

methods.name: insertImage
methods.description: Inserts an image from a source URL, with optional callback or filename.

methods.name: insertImages
methods.description: Inserts multiple image files.

methods.name: insertImagesOrCallback
methods.description: Inserts images via callback or data URL.

methods.name: getSelectedText
methods.description: Returns the currently selected plain text.

methods.name: onFormatBlock
methods.description: Formats the selected block with a specified tag.

methods.name: formatPara
methods.description: Formats the current block as a paragraph.

methods.name: fontStyling
methods.description: Applies CSS styles to selected text spans.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Removes hyperlink from selected anchor.

methods.name: getLinkInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about the link at the cursor.

methods.name: addRow
methods.description: Adds a row to a table at the current selection.

methods.name: addCol
methods.description: Adds a column to a table at the current selection.

methods.name: deleteRow
methods.description: Deletes the table row at the current selection.

methods.name: deleteCol
methods.description: Deletes the table column at the current selection.

methods.name: deleteTable
methods.description: Deletes the table at the current selection.

methods.name: resizeTo
methods.description: Resizes an image element to specified dimensions, optionally maintaining aspect ratio.

methods.name: hasFocus
methods.description: Checks if the editable area has focus.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Sets focus to the editable area.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the editable content is empty.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Clears all content and resets to an empty paragraph.

methods.name: normalizeContent
methods.description: Normalizes the DOM content within the editable area.
